# fflate

`fflate.js` is the unmodified ESM browser build of fflate 0.8.2, retrieved using `npm pack fflate@0.8.2` with npm's integrity verification. MIT license: `fflate.LICENSE`.

Source: https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate

It is loaded only in the private EPUB-import worker. Limits on archive size, entry count, expanded bytes, and worker duration are applied by Folio. No EPUB content is injected as executable HTML or uploaded to a server.
